detail.title: Synthesis of Prebiotic Chemical Heredity and Error Thresholds
detail.summary: This update revises the research notebooks for chemical memory transitions and prebiotic error thresholds, incorporating established evidence on thermodynamic frameworks and autocatalytic stability. The notebooks clarify the distinction between compositional persistence and template-based heredity while defining the error thresholds required for informational stability.
